<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
svd(x) -> tuple
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Singular value decomposition (numpy `linalg.svd`,
`full_matrices=False`).

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` of shape `(..., m, n)` (batched; rectangular
  allowed).

## Returns

- `tuple` — `(u, s, vh)` tuple of `SymbolicTensor`s: `u (..., m, k)`, `s (..., k)`, `vh (..., k, n)` with `k = min(m, n)`. `u`/`vh` keep the input dtype (int/bool → float64); `s` is REAL at the input's precision (complex64 → float32, complex128 → float64).

## Raises

- `core.TraceError` — no active trace; concrete `Tensor` operand.

- `core.ShapeError` — rank < 2.
